interpretation: The completed multiplicity-one-through-eight campaign is preserved unchanged, bound by the exact serialized historical census. The ledger is its disjoint union with verified continuation and independently replayed multiplicity-nine certificates. Unfinished searches remove nothing.
verification_scope: Historical continuation certificates retain their frozen exact-replay evidence, checked against unchanged source and proof-file hashes; they are not replayed for this extension. Every new multiplicity-nine certificate has a complete independent optimized exact replay bound to its proof and source tensor. The unchanged original negative catalogue retains the original exact campaign evidence; this build does not repeat that entire replay.
